response.overview: Located in the heart of the Indian Himalayas at an altitude of 2,652 meters, the remote "Malana Village" preserves a unique cannabis culture passed down for thousands of years. Exploring how the world-famous rare hashish "Malana Cream" is born, this documentary delves into the villagers' faith in Shiva, their unique language, a way of life isolated from the outside world, and the traditional Charas-making method. Recorded in October 2025, the film reveals what the people of this community protect and how they live in modern India, where cannabis is regulated by law.
response.title: Malana Cream: Original Charas
